name: proofsettle-thin-file-scorer
description: A small credit-scoring model for applicants with no credit file, over features a lender can compute from mobile money and supplier records. It is deliberately weighted towards behaviour (regular inflows, suppliers paid on time, no defaults) rather than length of history, because a thin file is the case it exists for. Weights were fitted on synthetic data and are published so anyone can recompute the model hash and rerun a score. The point of this model is not its quality. It is that the exact model a buyer names is the one that runs, and that a hardware attestation says so.

features.name: inflows_per_month
features.note: count of incoming payments per month

features.name: inflow_regularity
features.note: share of months with at least one inflow, 0 to 1

features.name: balance_volatility
features.note: coefficient of variation of end of month balance, 0 to 1

features.name: supplier_on_time_ratio
features.note: share of supplier invoices paid on time, 0 to 1

features.name: prior_loans_repaid
features.note: count of prior loans fully repaid
